# SkyWatch Security Ltd

> Commercial security services website for SkyWatch Security Ltd. Coverage is described on the About page as Luton-based operations across Bedfordshire, Hertfordshire, and Greater London. Use the linked pages for services, contact details, and policies.

## Services

- [Security services catalogue](https://skywatchsecurity.co.uk/services): Index of commercial security services published on this site.
- [Static site and manned guarding](https://skywatchsecurity.co.uk/services/manned-security-guards): On-site guarding and gate access.
- [Key holding and alarm response](https://skywatchsecurity.co.uk/services/key-holding-alarm-response): Key custody and alarm attendance.
- [Mobile patrols](https://skywatchsecurity.co.uk/services/mobile-patrols): Vehicle patrols and lock–unlock visits.
- [Construction site security](https://skywatchsecurity.co.uk/services/construction-security): Compound and plant protection.
- [Warehouse and logistics security](https://skywatchsecurity.co.uk/services/industrial-warehouse): Distribution and logistics sites.
- [All service pages](https://skywatchsecurity.co.uk/services): Concierge, corporate, CCTV, events, retail, reception, door supervision, campuses, foot patrols, dog handling, close protection, and dedicated guarding operations.
